maddeler.e:
ننسجن (form VII)
# نَنْسَجِنُ (nansajinu) /nan.sa.d͡ʒi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَجَنَ (insajana)
# نَنْسَجِنَ (nansajina) /nan.sa.d͡ʒi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَجَنَ (insajana)
# نَنْسَجِنْ (nansajin) /nan.sa.d͡ʒin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَجَنَ (insajana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
